meaning: sticky rice with chicken wrapped in lotus leaf
usage: No6 mai5 gai1 is used as a noun to refer to a specific type of dim sum dish.
You can say 'I want to order no6 mai5 gai1' when you're at a dim sum restaurant.
No6 mai5 gai1 usually appears on the menu under classic steamed dim sum.
It can also be a part of a sentence describing liking or disliking no6 mai5 gai1.
You can use no6 mai5 gai1 when asking someone if they want to share dim sum.
